scope: F49 handout masters, notes page dimensions and print/view property inventory, with explicit text scope and unrelated-slide retention

directInventoryFinding.method: Review all source identities for handout, notes_size/notes_width/notes_height and print/view properties. last_printed is core metadata; chart top-view and last-slide-viewed enums are unrelated. No direct F49 public member or test is present in the pinned inventories.

adjacentOpcCase.disposition: Observable operation behavior covered by original content type tests; handout inventory adds relationship identity evidence, not live-model parity.

originalTests.name: selects an override before a default for %s
originalTests.equivalence: The view-properties MIME value is independently expected for an override, while the mixed-case main-part variant independently asserts canonical case-insensitive lookup; the resolver is MIME-agnostic. Together these preserve the source observable variant without source assets.

additiveObligations: Read linked handout masters without creating missing parts; resolve canonical targets and Strict/Transitional namespaces.
Inventory notes page size and raw print/view attributes; absent values remain absent.
Retain unsupported placeholders, shape/layout XML, extensions and resource relationships.
Default slide text replacement excludes handout master text; explicit handout-master scope edits only supported text and validates identity.
Slide add/duplicate/remove/reorder/import/split operations retain unrelated handout resources according to operation semantics.
Inspect/schema/capabilities and SDK agree; no printer, renderer, native process, network or automatic pagination.

cases.name: lists presentation handouts without promoting detached resources (strict=%s)
exposes stored print and view markup without inferring pagination (strict=%s)
rejects external view properties without accessing their target
rejects a listed handout whose relationship identity is absent

domain.reportedBy: domain worker; focused tests and package lint passed

corpus.limits: Bounded read/mutation preservation QA; no render, pagination, complete print profile or full public API claim.
